description: This Java source file defines a UI Automator test case for setting a two-minute alarm on an Android device. It includes automation logic for interacting with Android UI elements such as the Clock app, setting an alarm, and verifying its activation. The code demonstrates using UiAutomator APIs to perform UI-driven testing of alarm functionality.

classes.name: SetTwoMinuteAlarm
classes.description: Main test class extending UiAutomatorTestCase, designed to automate setting a two-minute alarm and verifying it via UI interactions.

classes.name: LauncherHelper
classes.description: Utility inner class providing static UiSelector objects for locating launcher components such as 'All Apps' button, launcher container, and app icons.

methods.name: testDemo
methods.description: Main test method that automates navigating to the Clock app, setting an alarm 2 minutes from now, and verifying the alarm goes off.

methods.name: setAlarm
methods.description: Helper method to set an alarm for a specified number of minutes from now.

methods.name: clickByDescription
methods.description: Utility method to click UI objects by their content description.

methods.name: clickByText
methods.description: Utility method to click UI objects by their visible text.
